runs.text: Write between 2 and 4 test cases for the cinema program, so that any wrong version fails at least one of them.

hints.text: The wrong versions move the edge or swap the prices. Which ages notice those changes?
Use the partition: one case per region is not enough if the edge moves one step.
Choose both sides of the edge.
uncover them all. Close with the variant.

runs.text: Why are 10 and 30 not enough? (No version that moves the edge one step changes what it charges at 10 or at 30.)

Wrong versions: including 12, edge at 11, edge at 13 and swapped prices. The one that includes 12 and the one with the edge at 13 are the same as each other for whole ages, but neither is the same as the right one.
